# Generated by go run ./cmd/compose from the agent VM source. Don't edit by hand.
#
# Four processes (docs/22), each in its own container with its own uid, linked only by unix sockets: agentd
# (front door and runtime; no network, no keys), runner (runnerd: the brain in a gVisor sandbox, rootless runsc; no
# network, no keys, no capabilities), gatewayd (service "agentvm": the only network and the published port) and
# vaultd (the keys; no network). A one-shot setup container (root, no network) gives them their directories first.
#
# Every image is named by digest only: the pinned distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13@sha256:2293b36c7c9082bf4115aab724b4d2cddec82c8eba39bf27ac0517e159acf150)
# plus one layer with the binaries at /tacy/<name>; runnerd's image also holds the brain and, in a layer of its own,
# gVisor 20261012.0 at /tacy/gvisor (Google's release https://storage.googleapis.com/gvisor/releases/release/20261012.0/x86_64/gvisor.tar.bz2,
# sha256 180dd277f657c1478f09490e8a9a595f7378257510b43d1d3694a769aef9ed02, each binary checked; its Apache-2.0 LICENSE at
# /tacy/gvisor/LICENSE). Rebuild them from the tagged source (scripts/reproduce.sh) to get the same digests.
# Binaries (linux/amd64, sha256):
#   agentd   ccac762b541fe7189836f61a6b7595444aeaf65a06710bb15795ed7d4dacde9b
#   brain    7c984294c1b91fd5c27fb407d655bb2536b35e427b23b6d5082055e73d88cf60
#   gatewayd d94c9dfd41f2012afc1e9727afaf05188dbf0fa6a40614dd21bb62b614b86fb2
#   runnerd  b1c1a2432beaf866395941d4d598ade89a0e885e226c6e13c5d2a4c359990bcb
#   setup    80f380d97b1cc77da758d69ba978e5f09c720f10ef853f6afa06e06ffa006de6
#   vaultd   483c012e00b3794934dfe51fb78f9041ee6ad52ba1707822453d89cd2aefe851
#            56996c546dbafd5716e1d09e307a131d97eb3b6483c22a1178631751f3e0392f (gVisor runsc)
#            1755e10a4c9d1db4973c0155497348db3737543b4c2e6a9f663a271ee71433d5 (gVisor gvisor-bin/gvisor_sentry)
#            46d5c028723ac5fbe40b863f95100f15a00d2aa0cd39c69d892500a988c930bd (gVisor gvisor-bin/gvisor-sentry-prewarmer)
#            03af90d07ea466c10ecc3e3ba839b2a59540959dd3286aea3886917cba850c11 (gVisor gvisor-bin/runsc-fd-parking)
services:
  setup:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/setup@sha256:7c33f77d06d41b1f14c0729fd52abbabd657ec5e418e16fd17deac35bb607a0e
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/setup"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: "no"
    logging:
      driver: none
    user: "0:0"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    cap_add: [CHOWN, DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    volumes:
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
    command: ["-dir", "/run/tacy/agent=10003:10001:0770", "-dir", "/run/tacy/vault=10002:10001:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/runner=10004:10003:0750", "-dir", "/run/tacy/ops=10001:10001:0750"]

      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
    command: ["-runner-socket", "/run/tacy/runner/runner.sock", "-gateway-socket", "/run/tacy/agent/gateway.sock", "-listen-unix", "/run/tacy/agent/http.sock", "-listen-uid", "10001", "-listen-gid", "10001", "-mem-limit-mib", "600", "-relay-auth-key", "ed25519:HwAuJy8LJPfmHSB0nECuC9OD2PzXVKVn7+wdm89pWIo=", "-kms-key", "ed25519:1LPZHjHaCjYvuibeGa0PcuFHEIadIxsp8x9EbNNMmEg=", "-kms-hosts", "1", "-state", "relay", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a"]

    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:

    depends_on:

    mem_limit: 640m
    memswap_limit: 640m
    pids_limit: 512

    volumes:
      - runnersock:/run/tacy/runner
    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/runner/runner.sock", "-agent-uid", "10003", "-gvisor", "/tacy/gvisor", "-gvisor-release", "20261012.0", "-runsc-sha256", "56996c546dbafd5716e1d09e307a131d97eb3b6483c22a1178631751f3e0392f", "-brain", "/tacy/brain", "-brain-sha256", "7c984294c1b91fd5c27fb407d655bb2536b35e427b23b6d5082055e73d88cf60", "-dir", "/run/runner", "-platform", "systrap", "-rootless"]
  agentvm:

    entrypoint: ["/tacy/gatewayd"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:

        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10001:10001"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    tmpfs: [/tmp]
    volumes:
      - agentsock:/run/tacy/agent
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
    environment:

    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/agent/gateway.sock", "-agent-uid", "10003", "-vault-socket", "/run/tacy/vault/vault.sock", "-listen", ":8080", "-forward", "/run/tacy/agent/http.sock", "-search-provider", "exa", "-expected-keys", "TINFOIL_API_KEY,EXA_API_KEY,TAVILY_API_KEY", "-kms-url", "https://f7064d961aa473c26b6f9a050bb839e0ddb00e36-8000.dstack-pha1-prod5.phala.network", "-state-url", "https://chat.tacy.io", "-ops-socket", "/run/tacy/ops/gateway.sock", "-vault-uid", "10002", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a", "-safety-url", "https://chat.tacy.io/api/safety/docs", "-keylog-url", "https://chat.tacy.io/api/safety/keylog", "-dns-tls", "dns.quad9.net@9.9.9.9:853,149.112.112.112:853"]
  vaultd:
    image: ghcr.io/tacyhq/tacy/vaultd@sha256:42983966168f6943c54f31dbd09cfa7830c604a41f737b315fbb202e11b40044
    entrypoint: ["/tacy/vaultd"]
    network_mode: none
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: none
    depends_on:
      setup:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    user: "10002:10001"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    volumes:
      - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
      - vaultsock:/run/tacy/vault
      - opssock:/run/tacy/ops
    command: ["-socket", "/run/tacy/vault/vault.sock", "-gateway-uid", "10001", "-group-mode", "-kms-key", "ed25519:1LPZHjHaCjYvuibeGa0PcuFHEIadIxsp8x9EbNNMmEg=", "-kms-hosts", "1", "-ops-socket", "/run/tacy/ops/gateway.sock", "-firm", "f_chat", "-personal-spaces", "-operator-key", "ed25519:UjnT9P6APMBeNg5pJlGCLbwOKDlVJQO3m3+yDzby2os=", "-keylog-genesis", "a35f4cb79bd5066638a0fd0aa8dc855b951febba003e6a6fd3e335adc8d47cfd", "-keylog-carry", "e6f08a761337f9a367594c3ed43a07723ac50cbf790f5b740e25442d9a8c7496,b1cf194b7246c31a565f7c11de8416f16c377a461976dd9eb8a4e290cef1fe1a"]
